scripts.dev: pnpm -C packages/server-core build && concurrently -k "pnpm -C packages/server-core build --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm -C packages/server dev" "pnpm -C packages/web dev"
scripts.dev:build: pnpm -C packages/web build && pnpm -C packages/server dev
scripts.dev:server: pnpm -C packages/server-core build && concurrently -k "pnpm -C packages/server-core build --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm -C packages/server dev"
scripts.build:real-apps: VITE_LOCALAPP_ACCEPTANCE_ROOT="$PWD/tmp/unified-acceptance/installed-skills" pnpm -C examples/skill-market build && pnpm -C examples/resume-manager build
scripts.test:real-apps: pnpm run build:real-apps && pnpm -C packages/server exec vitest run tests/e2e-unified/real-apps.spec.ts
